name: Primary Button

seo.description: Primary action button with Ocean Professional focus ring and subtle shadow.

notes: Use for primary call to action. Ensure only one primary button per view for clarity.
description: A primary call-to-action button with solid style.
short: Solid primary CTA with gradient accent.
responsiveNotes: Works across sizes; width adapts to content.
code: <button className="px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 transition">Primary</button>

name: Secondary Button

seo.description: Secondary button with subtle hover and focus rings.

notes: Pair with primary buttons or use as neutral action. Avoid equal prominence with primary.
description: A neutral secondary button for less prominent actions.
short: Neutral action button with subtle hover.
responsiveNotes: Adapts to container width; pairs with primary button.

name: Status Badge

seo.description: Rounded badge with Ocean Professional colors.

notes: Use semantic colors. Keep text short. Badges should not be focusable unless interactive.
description: Small badge used to denote statuses, tags, or counts.
short: Compact label for statuses or tags.
responsiveNotes: Badges flow inline; wrap as needed.

name: Info Alert
jsxCode: <InfoAlert title="Heads up" message="This is an informational alert." />

seo.description: Info alert with blue accent and focusable close button.

notes: Announce important info with role=alert if dynamically inserted; avoid overuse.
description: An informational alert with icon and accessible markup.

name: Success Alert
jsxCode: <SuccessAlert title="All set" message="Your changes have been saved." />

seo.description: Success alert with subtle shadow and Ocean palette.

notes: Use for positive confirmations. Consider dismiss actions and timed disappearance in toasts.
description: A success alert with green accent and icon.

name: Basic Card

seo.description: Card with subtle shadow and rounded corners.

notes: Cards are containers for grouped content. Keep vertical rhythm consistent across lists.
description: A simple card container with header and body.
responsiveNotes: Width scales with parent container; content wraps.
code:
Card Header

Card body content...

name: Media Card
jsxCode: <MediaCard title="Ocean Sunset" description="A calming gradient with blue and amber accents." imageUrl="/path" />

previewProps.title: Ocean Sunset
previewProps.description: A calming gradient with blue and amber accents.

seo.description: Media card optimized for responsive layouts.

notes: Use loading="lazy" for images and include descriptive alt text.
description: Card with image thumbnail, title, and description.
short: Media card with thumbnail and text.

name: Top Navigation

seo.description: Top navigation with Ocean gradient accent on hover.

notes: Ensure navigation landmarks (role=navigation) and skip links when used in real layouts.
description: A responsive top navigation bar with brand and actions.
responsiveNotes: Links collapse or wrap on narrow viewports.

name: Simple Navbar

seo.description: Simple navbar with clean spacing and hover styles.

notes: Use semantic header and nav elements; ensure link focus visibility.
description: Minimal navbar with brand and inline links.

name: Basic Modal

seo.description: Modal with Ocean focus rings and subtle drop shadow.

notes: For production, add focus trapping, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and ESC/overlay dismissal.
description: Accessible modal dialog with overlay and focus trapping.
responsiveNotes: Dialog centers and scales on small screens.

name: Text Input

seo.description: Input with Ocean blue focus ring and rounded corners.

notes: Always associate labels with inputs. Ensure sufficient contrast on placeholder text.
description: A standard text input with focus styles.

name: Email Input

seo.description: Email input styled for accessibility and clarity.

notes: Use type=email for mobile keyboard optimization and basic validation.
description: Email input with validation-friendly styles.

name: Input
description: Basic text input with label, helper text, and accessible focus ring.
notes: Always associate labels using <label> and visible text. Show errors beneath the field.

name: Input Group
short: Input with leading addon and trailing button.
description: Compose inline addons and actions around inputs for URLs, search, etc.
notes: Ensure addons are not focusable unless interactive. Keep hit targets 44px high.

name: Textarea
description: Accessible textarea with label and helper.
notes: Avoid fixed heights; allow rows to be adjustable or resizable as needed.

name: File Input
short: Choose file button with filename field.
description: Styled file chooser with separate trigger and read-only filename preview.
notes: Keep native input for accessibility and keyboard support. Announce constraints (type/size).

name: Checkbox
description: Form checkbox with accessible label and focus ring.
notes: Use fieldset/legend for grouped checkboxes. Ensure a clear hit area.

name: Radio Group
short: Select a single option from a list.
description: Simple radio group with legend and accessible roles.
notes: Wrap related radios in a fieldset with a descriptive legend.

name: Switch
description: Accessible switch using role='switch' and aria-checked.
notes: Use switches for immediate actions; use checkboxes for form submissions.

name: Select
description: Simple select with label and focus styles.
notes: Native select provides best accessibility; custom selects require extensive a11y work.

name: Range Slider
description: Input range styled with accent color and value display.
notes: Consider keyboard support and visible value; ensure contrast on the track and thumb.

name: Color Picker (Tailwind)
short: Native color input with Tailwind styles.
description: Use the built-in color input as a simple picker.
notes: For advanced UI, consider react-colorful.

name: Time Picker
short: Native time input with Tailwind styling.
description: Simple time selection field using the native time input.
notes: For richer features (seconds, range, formats) consider react-time-picker.

name: Contact Form

seo.description: Form with Ocean focus rings and clear label hierarchy.

notes: Validate fields and show helpful error messages. Consider ARIA live regions for async submit.
description: A simple contact form layout with name, email, and message.
responsiveNotes: Single column on small screens; wider spacing on desktop.

name: Pagination

seo.description: Accessible pagination with keyboard focus states.

notes: Include aria-current for active page and label the nav with aria-label='Pagination'.
description: Basic pagination controls with previous/next and pages.
responsiveNotes: Pages wrap on small viewports; primary color highlights current.

name: Breadcrumbs
notes: Wrap in nav with aria-label='Breadcrumb' for assistive tech.
description: Breadcrumb navigation trail for hierarchy.
responsiveNotes: Text wraps gracefully; separators are subtle.

name: Date Picker
notes: Recommended library: react-day-picker. Install: npm i react-day-picker. See Details for lazy import example.
description: A basic date picker with calendar UI.
responsiveNotes: Use mobile-friendly input on small screens.

name: Color Picker
notes: Recommended library: react-colorful. Install: npm i react-colorful. Use lazy import and suspense for optional enhancement.
description: A modern color picker component.
responsiveNotes: Provide text input fallback for keyboard users.

name: Container
description: A responsive container with max-width variants and balanced horizontal padding.
notes: Use as a top-level wrapper for pages or sections.

name: Columns
short: Responsive grid columns with gap control.
description: A simple grid wrapper that maps responsive column counts to Tailwind classes.
notes: Use gap as Tailwind spacing scale token (e.g., 4, 6, 8).

name: Grid
jsxCode: <Grid cols={12} gap={4}>{/* GridItem or elements with col-span-* */}</Grid>
short: Generic CSS grid with column count and gap.
description: A utility grid with configurable columns, gap, and auto-rows.
notes: Combine with col-span-* classes or GridItem helper.

name: Layout Splitter
description: A simple resizable two-column layout. Plain React with mouse events, no external libs.
notes: Ensure proper aria-orientation and role=separator for accessibility.

name: Typography
description: Common text styles including headings, paragraphs, code and keyboard indicators.
notes: Prefer semantic elements (h1–h6, p) and maintain single H1 per page. Use <kbd> elements for keyboard hints or pair with the KBD sample.

name: Images
description: Responsive image display with object-cover and rounded containers.
notes: Always include descriptive alt text for accessibility.

name: Links
description: Accessible link styles for text and button-like anchors.
notes: Ensure focus outlines are visible and meaningful.

name: Dividers & hr
description: Simple horizontal rules and a labeled divider pattern.
notes: Prefer semantic hr for visual separation between content blocks.

name: Custom Scrollbar
description: A scrollable container using a reusable custom-scrollbar utility class.
notes: Cross-browser support: uses both standard and WebKit properties; includes dark mode.

name: KBD
description: Small, rounded kbd elements to display keyboard shortcuts and combinations.
notes: Use the semantic <kbd> HTML element. Group combos with + separators and provide accessible labels.

name: Accordion

items.title: What is Ocean theme?
items.content: A clean modern palette with blue and amber accents.

items.title: Is it accessible?
items.content: Yes — focus outlines, roles, and keyboard support included.

seo.description: Accessible accordion built with details/summary and Tailwind.

notes: Tailwind-only using <details>/<summary> and optional JS for single-open behavior. Make summary focusable with keyboard support (Enter/Space toggles).
description: Disclosure list with expand/collapse sections.

name: Warning Alert

previewProps.title: Heads up
previewProps.message: Please review the changes before proceeding.

description: Warning alert with amber accent and icon.
notes: Use role='alert' only when dynamically rendered and important to announce.

name: Error Alert
description: Destructive alert with red accent and icon.
notes: Reserve for important blocking errors. Provide remediation or contact info.

name: Avatar
description: Circular avatar showing image or initials fallback.
notes: Include alt text. Generate initials when image fails to load.

name: Avatar Group
description: Compact group of avatars with overflow indicator.
notes: Ensure avatar order has meaning. Provide tooltips or labels for names.

name: Badge
jsxCode: New
description: Simple solid badge for statuses and tags.
notes: Use color for meaning and pair with text for accessibility.

name: Blockquote
jsxCode: Quote
description: Semantic blockquote with subtle accent.
notes: Prefer <figure> with <figcaption> and cite when attribution is present.

name: Button Group
description: Segmented controls with connected corners and focus rings.
notes: Use aria-pressed on toggle buttons; consider role='tablist' for tabs-like behavior.

name: Chat Bubbles
description: Message bubbles with tails and timestamps.
notes: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for typing indicators.

name: Carousel
description: CSS scroll-snap carousel with buttons; no external libs.
notes: Tailwind-only: use overflow-x-auto and scroll-snap. For advanced features consider a library.

name: Collapse
description: Disclosure control for simple hide/show.
notes: Use aria-expanded and aria-controls when not using details/summary.

name: Devices
description: CSS-only mock devices (phone/laptop) for showcasing screenshots.
notes: Use background and border radii to suggest devices. Keep alt text meaningful.

name: Lists
description: Common list patterns with spacing and markers.
notes: Prefer semantic lists (<ul>/<ol>) and consistent vertical rhythm.

name: List Group
description: Stacked list items with dividers and states.
notes: Use role='list' and role='listitem' for non-semantic wrappers.

name: Legend Indicator
description: Compact legend items used in charts and keys.
notes: Ensure color alone isn’t the only differentiator; include labels.

name: Progress
description: Accessible progress bar with label and ARIA attributes.
notes: Use role='progressbar' and aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax.

name: File Uploading Progress
description: Upload list item with thumbnail, name, and progress.
notes: Indicate paused/failed states with icons and colors.

name: Ratings
description: Pure CSS star rating using masks or layered icons.
notes: Tailwind-only demo with SVG stars. For interactive ratings, consider a library.

name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder bars and blocks.
notes: Respect reduced motion; provide aria-busy or progress indicators for assistive tech.

name: Spinners
description: Indeterminate loaders with reduced-motion support.
notes: Use aria-live politely for longer operations; avoid infinite blockers.

name: Styled Icons
description: Icon system with sizes, colors, and containers.
notes: Use a central icon registry. Mind accessible labels for standalone icons.

name: Toasts
description: CSS-only toast stack with transitions.
notes: Tailwind-only demo using absolute container and transitions. For portals & ARIA live regions, consider a library.

name: Timeline
description: Ordered events with connectors and meta.
notes: Use aria-describedby for date/metadata and ensure good contrast.

name: Tree View
description: Keyboard accessible tree with disclosure triangles.
notes: Add roving tabindex and aria-expanded for complete accessibility in production.

name: Navbar
short: Responsive top navigation with brand and links.
description: Responsive top navigation bar with hamburger toggle on mobile and accessible controls.
notes: Mobile menu uses a controlled boolean state and accessible button with aria-expanded.

name: Mega Menu
short: CSS-only large panel menu using hover/focus-within.
description: A large dropdown panel organized in columns; opens using CSS hover/focus-within.
notes: Relies on group-hover and focus-within for accessibility. Consider Escape handling if enhanced with JS.

name: Navs
description: Basic nav patterns used for in-page navigation or settings sections.
notes: Use button or anchor elements depending on routing needs.

name: Tabs
short: Tabs with keyboard navigation and ARIA roles.
description: Keyboard-accessible tabs with Arrow/Home/End navigation and roving tabindex.
notes: Implements ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End, roving tabindex, and ARIA roles.

name: Sidebar
description: Vertical sidebar with grouped sections; great for docs or settings.
notes: Use sticky positioning for docs-like layouts.

name: Scrollspy
short: Table of contents that highlights active section.
description: Highlights the active section in a sidebar while scrolling, using IntersectionObserver.
notes: Ensure sections have unique IDs and use scroll-mt for anchor offset.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb trail showing the current page hierarchy.
notes: Wrap with nav[aria-label='Breadcrumb'] for semantics.

name: Pagination
description: Pagination controls with current page highlighting and hover states.
notes: Use semantic nav and aria-label for pagination. Include aria-current for active page.

name: Stepper
description: Show progress through a sequence of steps with active/completed states.
notes: Use semantic list or nav if steps are navigable.

name: Advanced Select
description: Tailwind-only searchable select with listbox pattern, type-ahead filter, and keyboard navigation.
notes: Uses a listbox pattern (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, role=listbox, aria-selected) and supports keyboard type-ahead. Ensure focus is managed and the trigger button has an accessible name.

name: ComboBox
description: Autocomplete input that allows free typing or choosing from suggestions.
notes: Follows ARIA combobox pattern: input with aria-autocomplete, role=listbox for results, and aria-activedescendant for highlighting. Use Headless UI Combobox for full a11y coverage.

name: Search Box
short: Input with search and clear controls.
description: A compact search field with leading icon and actions.
notes: Ensure the search button has discernible text for screen readers and use a form submit for Enter key handling.

name: Input Number
description: Accessible numeric field with +/- buttons and min/max clamping.
notes: Buttons include aria-labels for screen readers. Validate input and clamp on change.

name: Strong Password
description: Shows a visual strength bar and label based on basic heuristics.
notes: Use aria-live=polite for dynamic strength feedback. Do not rely solely on client-side checks.

name: Toggle Password
description: Password input with inline show/hide control for convenience.
notes: The toggle button uses aria-pressed to reflect state and has an accessible name. Ensure focus order remains logical.

name: Toggle Count
description: Demonstrates toggled enabled state that gates actions like increment.
notes: Primary toggle uses aria-pressed to convey state. Disable the increment button when the toggle is off for clarity and accessibility.

name: Copy Markup
jsxCode: <CopyMarkup code={'<button class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-blue-600 text-white">Click</button>'} />
description: Displays code and copies it to clipboard with feedback.
notes: Uses the Clipboard API; include aria-live feedback for success. Provide non-JS fallback if needed.

name: PIN Input
description: Series of single-character inputs for short codes (OTP/PIN).
notes: Use inputMode='numeric' and aria-labels for each cell. Support backspace and arrow navigation. Announce submission on final digit with aria-live if auto-submit.

name: Dropdown
short: Button menu with list of actions.
description: Simple dropdown anchored to a button using absolute positioning.
notes: Closes on outside click. For focus trapping and placement logic, consider Floating UI.

name: Context Menu
description: Demonstrates preventing default context menu and rendering a custom one.
notes: Ensure keyboard access via trigger buttons for accessibility.

name: Offcanvas (Drawer)
description: Drawer panel that slides in from the right to show contextual content.
notes: Consider focus trap and inert background for production.

name: Popover
short: Small card anchored to a trigger.
description: Lightweight popover for supplemental content.
notes: For dynamic placement and flipping, use Floating UI.

name: Tooltip
description: Basic tooltip shown on hover. No positioning lib required.
notes: For accessibility, ensure focus-triggered tooltips. Consider @tippyjs/react for advanced behavior.

name: Modal (Accessible)
short: Dialog with overlay and focus trapping.
description: Accessible modal with overlay dismissal, Escape to close, and keyboard focus trap.
notes: For production, prefer a robust dialog like @headlessui/react Dialog or Radix Dialog for a11y edge cases.
